League Of Legends Betting Odds: What The Exchange Lists

League of Legends betting odds trade on Kalshi as event contracts: every professional match gets exactly two markets, one per team, each priced in cents, and each contract pays $1 if that team wins and nothing if it does not. The position stays tradeable through the match and settles the instant the winner is declared, and the League book opens earlier and runs deeper than most of the esports catalog. The full measurements are below: the three-day market clock, the depth table across four esports, and the one match that traded almost four million contracts.

Lead with the mechanic, because it is the real difference between League on an exchange and League at a sportsbook. Every Kalshi esports match market is flagged to close early: in the exchange's own words, the market "will close and expire after a winner is declared." There is no grading queue. The Nexus falls, holders of the winning side collect $1 per contract, holders of the losing side collect nothing, and the ticker is finished.
